Name: Sonic CD
Description: Rather than a straight port or an emulated title, this version of the 1993 Sonic CD is a completely redone edition for modern platforms, based on a fan-made Retro engine.

Achievements.Description: Pass the upper signpost in Collision Chaos Zone 2.

Achievements.Name: Statue Saviour

Achievements.Description: Defeat Metal Sonic without getting hurt.
